suppress.notes: file name: cxf-rt-bindings-soap-3.5.5.jar False positive as the vulnerability is in apache soap project and not cxf-rt-bindings-soap
False positive for org.eclipse.parsson:parsson. This project uses org.glassfish:javax.json for JSON processing

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

False-positive CPE matches for Apache CXF 3.6.13. Apache's security advisories identify 3.6.12 as the fixed version for these CVEs. The project uses 3.6.13, the latest available 3.6.x patch release. See https://cxf.apache.org/security-advisories.html Keep this exception scoped to the verified version until the vulnerability data is corrected.
